_comments.note: Standard JSON has no // comments. This _comments block is for you only; the script ignores it.
_comments.mode: frame_fade_bridge = fade-out last frame, then fade-in first frame of next clip (no overlap).
_comments.gap_duration_sec: Total gap between clips = fade_out_sec + fade_in_sec.
_comments.fade_out_sec: Seconds to fade out the last frame of the current clip.
_comments.fade_in_sec: Seconds to fade in the first frame of the next clip.
_comments.transition_fps: FPS used for fade bridges and merged output (60 = smooth).

clip_label_overlay.font_size: 0 = auto (~60px on 1080x1920). Fixed size in pixels: 48, 56, 64, 72 = bigger text. Minimum 16.
clip_label_overlay.line_gap: Extra pixels between each numbered line (increase if font_size is large).
clip_label_overlay.left_margin: Distance from the left edge of the video.
clip_label_overlay.top_margin: Distance from the top edge of the video.
clip_label_overlay.color: Label color: yellow, white, #00FFFF, etc. Use RANDOM for a different color per line.
clip_label_overlay.display_mode: synced = numbered list with text revealed per clip. all = show all labels on every clip.
clip_label_overlay.numbering: reverse = clip 1 text on last line (6.), clip 2 on line 5., etc. normal = clip 1 on line 1., clip 2 on line 2., etc. Revealed text stays visible for the rest of the video.
